subject: Your first 30-second summary is waiting
preview_text: One tap. Instant clarity. Try it now.
body_paragraphs: You just finished a meeting. Your head is buzzing with ideas, but they're already starting to blur. What was that one action item for next Tuesday? Who said they'd draft the budget? If you're like me, you replay the last 5 minutes in your head and still come up blank.

That's the moment Smart Notes was built for. Not for typing furiously, not for rewatching recordings, not for wondering if you missed something crucial. One tap and the app captures the entire conversation, transcribes it, and hands you a clean summary with key points and action items. It takes about 30 seconds from tap to clarity.

Open the app now and tap the big red button. Record a couple minutes of conversation—even just chatting with yourself about today's goals. Watch the transcription appear in real time, then hit 'Summarize'. You'll see what I mean: this is the feature users who stick with us use on day one, and it's the reason they never go back to messy notes.

Just open the app and try the one-tap record feature. You'll have your first summary in under a minute. P.S. Users who create their first summary today are 3x more likely to still be using Smart Notes a week from now. Don't let that first tap wait.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes and record your first meeting
